characters.name: Spark
characters.line: Hi, I'm Spark. I read the delivery note into strict JSON, look at the pallet and run the receiving agent. I'm quick to post, which is exactly why Kapı is here.

characters.name: Sam
characters.line: I'm Sam. I find every carton on the dock camera and outline it, pixel by pixel, and say how sure I am: 0.88 and up is sure. One day I'd like to look through the receiver's glasses instead of the ceiling.

characters.name: Voice
characters.line: I'm Voice. I write down what the receiver says at the dock, “on iki koli geldi”, so the gate gets a third count, and I notice when they aren't sure.

characters.name: Kapı
characters.line: I'm Kapı, Turkish for gate. I'm not a model, I'm ten rules in plain code. Nothing written on a note, not even in white ink, can talk me into posting. No agreement, no receipt.

characters.name: Şef
characters.line: I'm Şef, the human in the loop. A crushed carton, a stacked load, a number nobody can confirm: when Kapı isn't sure, the decision comes to me.

characters.name: Wonder
characters.line: I'm Wonder, the clerk. When Kapı stops a delivery I write the paperwork: the dispute to the supplier, the damage report, or a note to Şef. Only facts from the evidence, and nothing is sent until Şef approves.

characters.name: Ada
characters.line: I'm Ada, named after Ada Lovelace. With Muse Code I wrote the ERPNext client that turns Kapı's yes into a Purchase Receipt, its tests, and this page.

characters.name: Iris
characters.line: I'm Iris, the painter. With Muse Image I drew everyone on this page from Sena's concepts, myself included.

characters.name: Rover
characters.line: I'm Rover, Spark's open-weight cousin: I run on anyone's servers. Before Kapı lets a receipt through, I read the note again on my own, and if I read it differently, Şef takes a look.

characters.name: Glimmer
characters.line: I'm Glimmer, small and open. I read every note in the second-reader trial; Rover got the job: not one broken answer in 27.
